source_note: Keyless Free Dictionary API is preferred. Missing entries fall back to CMUdict US pronunciations converted from ARPABET to broad IPA, then Wiktionary-derived IPA. Imported phonetics remain externally sourced and require editorial review.

filming.definition: The action of the verb to film.

balance.definition: (uncountable) A state in which opposing forces harmonise; equilibrium.

investigation.definition: The act of investigating; the process of inquiring into or following up; research, especially patient or thorough inquiry or examination

aggressive.definition: Characterized by aggression; highly combative; prone to behave in a way that involves attacking (especially if unjustly) or arguing.

conclusion.definition: The end, finish, close or last part of something.

protester.definition: One who protests, either alone or in a public display of group feeling.

atrium.definition: (architecture) A central room or space in ancient Roman homes, open to the sky in the middle; a similar space in other buildings.

vehicle.definition: A conveyance: a spacious device for carrying or transporting substances, objects, people or animals.

administration.definition: (uncountable) The act of administering; government of public affairs; the service rendered, or duties assumed, in conducting affairs; the conducting of any office or employment; direction.

deemed.definition: An accreditation awarded to higher educational institutions in India.

scandal.definition: An incident or event that disgraces or damages the reputation of the persons or organization involved.

doxxed.definition: simple past and past participle of doxx

lawsuit.definition: (law) In civil law, a case where two or more people disagree and one or more of the parties take the case to a court for resolution.

allegation.definition: An assertion, especially an accusation, not necessarily based on facts.

screaming.definition: Loud, sharp, and piercing to the ear.

bonk.definition: (informal) To hit or strike; to collide with something.

pending.definition: Awaiting a conclusion or a confirmation.

lawyered up.definition: Having sufficient legal representation to protect oneself in the event of legal trouble

suspending.definition: present participle and gerund of suspend

survivor.definition: One who survives, especially one who survives a traumatic experience.

leaked.definition: Of a document, etc, produced by a company or organization, intended to be confidential but having been released to the public or the press.

campus.definition: The grounds or property of a school, college, university, business, church, or hospital, often understood to include buildings and other structures.

president.definition: The head of state of a republic, sometimes also the head of government as well, particularly (US politics) the head of the executive branch of the federal government of the United States of America.

publicly.definition: In public, openly, in an open and public manner.

worst.definition: (for non-slang definitions) superlative form of bad: most bad

outlet.definition: A vent or similar passage to allow the escape of something.

individual.definition: A person considered alone, rather than as belonging to a group of people.

conduct.definition: The act or method of controlling or directing.

potentially.definition: In a manner showing much potential; with the possibility of happening in a given way.

frat.definition: (often attributive) Shortened form of fraternity, college organization.

coverage.definition: An amount by which something or someone is covered.

contractor.definition: A person or company that builds or improves buildings or structures.

threatened.definition: (especially ecology, of an organism) At risk of becoming endangered in the near future.

disposal.definition: (countable) A disposition; an arrangement, categorization, or classification of things.

statistic.definition: A single item in a statistical study.

alcohol.definition: (organic chemistry, countable) Any of a class of organic compounds (such as ethanol) containing a hydroxyl functional group (-OH).

board member.definition: A member of a board in an association or company, especially the board of directors.

risk.definition: (uncountable) The probability of a negative outcome to a decision or event.

insurance company.definition: A company that provides insurance policies.

national.definition: Pertaining to a nation or country, especially as a whole; affecting, shared by, or existing throughout all of a nation.

chapter.definition: One of the main sections into which a published work is divided, especially a book.

umbrella.definition: A cloth-covered frame used for protection against rain or sun.

nightmare.definition: A very unpleasant or frightening dream.

rescinded.definition: simple past and past participle of rescind

membership.definition: The state of being a member of a group or organization.

power trip.definition: Any activity which confers a sense of power on the person involved.

policy.definition: A principle of behaviour, conduct which an entity (government, organization, etc.) applies or seeks to follow, especially as formally expressed by an authoritative body.

vendor.definition: A person or a company that vends or sells.

guest list.definition: A list of all the guests invited or allowed to enter an event.

limitation.definition: The act of limiting or the state of being limited.

third party.definition: (business, commerce) Someone not directly involved in a transaction; an entity beyond the seller (first party) and customer (second party).

foolproof.definition: Of a device: protected against, or designed to be proof against, misuse or error.

workaround.definition: A means of overcoming some obstacle, especially an obstacle consisting of constraints, or laws or regulations.

bylaw.definition: A local custom or law of a settlement or district.

violation.definition: The act or an instance of violating or the condition of being violated.

bypassing.definition: present participle and gerund of bypass

circumstantial.definition: Pertaining to or dependent on circumstances, especially as opposed to essentials; incidental, not essential.

claim.definition: A demand of ownership made for something.

absorb.definition: (transitive) To include so that it no longer has separate existence; to overwhelm; to cause to disappear as if by swallowing up; to incorporate; to assimilate; to take in and use up.

sodomized.definition: simple past and past participle of sodomize

assault.definition: A violent onset or attack with physical means, for example blows, weapons, etc.

iron.definition: (uncountable) A common, inexpensive metal, silvery grey when untarnished, that rusts, is attracted by magnets, and is used in making steel: a chemical element having atomic number 26 and symbol Fe.

branding.definition: The process in which a mark, usually a symbol or ornamental pattern, is burned into the skin of a living animal or person (usually a livestock animal).

rectum.definition: (anatomy) The terminal part of the large intestine through which feces pass after exiting the colon, but before leaving the body through the anus or cloaca.

insurance.definition: A means of indemnity against a future occurrence of an uncertain event.

sustain.definition: (transitive) To maintain, or keep in existence.

sued.definition: simple past and past participle of sue

organized.definition: (of things or settings) Having been organized; in good order.

guest.definition: A recipient of hospitality, especially someone staying by invitation at the house of another.

standard.definition: Falling within an accepted range of size, amount, power, quality, etc.

process.definition: A series of events leading to a result or product.

assume.definition: To authenticate by means of belief; to surmise; to suppose to be true, especially without proof.

donation.definition: A voluntary gift or contribution for a specific cause.

escape.definition: (intransitive) To get free; to free oneself.

beneficial.definition: Helpful or good to something or someone.

institution.definition: A custom or practice of a society or community.

Greek life.definition: (US) The activities of college fraternities and sororities.

financially.definition: In terms of finance or money.

housing.definition: (uncountable) The activity of enclosing something or providing a residence for someone.

marketing.definition: Buying and/or selling in a market (street market or market fair).

freshman.definition: (US, Canada, Philippines) a person (of either sex) entering the first year of an institution, especially a high school (ninth grade for US, grade 9 for Canada, grade 7 for Philippines), a university, or legislative body

ashamed.definition: (chiefly of someone in trouble and undergoing punishment for doing something wrong) Feeling shame or guilt.

pledged.definition: Under the obligation of a promise made.

relevant.definition: Related, connected, or pertinent to a topic.

coffin.definition: A closed box in which the body of a dead person is placed for burial.

inflicting.definition: present participle and gerund of inflict

waistband.definition: A band of fabric encircling the waist, especially a part of a pair of pants or a skirt.

addiction.definition: (medicine) A state that is characterized by compulsive drug use or compulsive engagement in rewarding behavior, despite negative consequences.

vinegar.definition: (uncountable) A sour liquid formed by the fermentation of alcohol used as a condiment or preservative; a dilute solution of acetic acid.

conquest.definition: An act or instance of achieving victory through combat; the subjugation of an enemy.

arrest.definition: A check; a stop; an act or instance of arresting something.

ketamine.definition: (pharmacology) A synthetic compound used as a dissociative anesthetic and analgesic drug and also recreationally as a hallucinogen.

overdosed.definition: simple past and past participle of overdose

chivalrous.definition: (of a man) Honourable, especially to women; gallant.

generous.definition: Noble in behaviour or actions; principled, not petty; kind, magnanimous.

sophomore.definition: (US) The second in a series, especially, the second of an artist’s albums or the second of four years in a high school (tenth grade) or university.

community.definition: (countable) A group sharing common characteristics, such as the same language, law, religion, or tradition.

promoting.definition: present participle and gerund of promote

supplying.definition: present participle and gerund of supply

active.definition: Having the power or quality of acting; causing change; communicating action or motion; acting;—opposed to passive, that receives.

investigate.definition: (transitive) To inquire into or study in order to ascertain facts or information.

suspension.definition: The act of suspending, or the state of being suspended.

sorority.definition: A group of girls or women associated for a common purpose; a sisterhood.

fentanyl.definition: (pharmacology) A synthetic opioid narcotic analgesic, C₂₂H₂₈N₂O, with pharmacological action similar to morphine that is administered transdermally as a skin patch and in the form of its citrate, C₂₂H₂₈N₂O·C₆H₈O₇, is administered orally or parenterally (as by intravenous or epidural injection); N-phenyl-N-[1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-yl]propanamide.

operational.definition: Of or relating to operations, especially military operations.

oversee.definition: (literally) To survey, look at something in a wide angle.

salaried.definition: Paid a salary, as opposed to being an hourly worker or a volunteer. Generally indicating a professional or manager.

vodka.definition: A clear distilled alcoholic liquor made from grain mash.

upkeep.definition: Maintenance; the act or effort of keeping something in good and working condition.

caretaker.definition: Someone who takes care of a place or thing; someone looking after a place, or responsible for keeping it in good repair.

separate.definition: (transitive) To divide (a thing) into separate parts.

establishment.definition: The act or process of establishing; a ratifying or ordaining; settlement; confirmation.

bartender.definition: One who tends a bar or pub; a person preparing and serving drinks at a bar. [from 19th c.]

wristband.definition: The cuff of a sleeve that wraps around the wrist.

unclear.definition: Ambiguous; liable to more than one interpretation.

awkwardly.definition: In an awkward manner; with discomfort or lack of coordination.

couch.definition: (Canada, US, Australia, Ireland) An item of furniture, often upholstered, for the comfortable seating of more than one person; a sofa.

dancing.definition: The activity of taking part in a dance.

propositioned.definition: simple past and past participle of proposition

pressuring.definition: An act or instance of somebody being pressured.

marijuana.definition: The inflorescence of the Cannabis sativa plant, smoked or ingested for euphoric effect.

erection.definition: (uncountable) The act of building or putting up or together of something.

unlocked.definition: Not secured or protected by a lock.

Snapchat.definition: (Internet, social media) A mobile photo-messaging application, introduced in 2011.

all caps.definition: (typography) Text or a font in which all letters are capitalised.

morally.definition: In terms of morals or ethics.

consensual.definition: With permission, with consensus, without coercion; allowed without objecting or resisting.

AFK.definition: (military, video games, Internet slang) Initialism of away from keyboard, i.e. away from one's computer; idle.

respond.definition: (transitive, intransitive) To say something in return; to answer; to reply.

low-key.definition: (art, photography) Dark; characterized by dark tones and muted colors.

manager.definition: (management) A person whose job is to manage something, such as a business, a restaurant, or a sports team.

hired.definition: simple past and past participle of hire

interaction.definition: The situation or occurrence in which two or more objects or events act upon one another to produce an effect; the effect resulting from such a situation or occurrence.

believed.definition: simple past and past participle of believe

considers.definition: third-person singular simple present indicative of consider

findings.definition: Small tools and materials used by artisans and craftsmen

intentional.definition: Intended or planned; done deliberately or voluntarily.

federal.definition: Pertaining to a league or treaty; derived from an agreement or covenant between parties, especially between nations.

academically.definition: In an academic style or way; from an academic perspective.

victim.definition: One that is harmed—killed, injured, subjected to oppression, deceit, or otherwise adversely affected—by someone or something, especially another person or event, force, or condition; in particular:

graduating.definition: present participle and gerund of graduate

emotionally.definition: In an emotional manner; displaying emotion.

haunt.definition: (transitive) To inhabit or to visit frequently (most often used in reference to ghosts).

mainstream.definition: Used or accepted broadly rather than by small portions of population, market, scientific community, etc.

recover.definition: (transitive) To get back, to regain (a physical thing; in astronomy and navigation, sight of a thing or a signal).

trauma.definition: Any injury to the body of a living thing.

retreat.definition: The act of pulling back or withdrawing, as from something dangerous, or unpleasant.

commences.definition: third-person singular simple present indicative of commence

equipped.definition: Having the equipment, resources, and skills one needs; prepared.

healing.definition: The process where the cells in the body regenerate and repair themselves.
